$comment: Prosary editorial translations of UGCC calendar DISPLAY TITLES requested by the user, not liturgical prayers or Scripture text and not official church editions. Exact English title identities, dates, ranks and precedence are unchanged. Existing sourced Hebrew titles are preserved; sourceByTitle records exact catalog matches. Newly translated display metadata has no claim of ecclesiastical approval. Pentecost uses the user-prescribed Hebrew שבועות. Numbered Sundays 1 through 40 and weekday compounds are expanded; exact aliases are harmless when an identity has no day in a generated year.
